summary: This change removes the legacy routines RPC, the `halo routine` CLI command and the routine stream update. It moves the workspace protocol to 26, keeps 25 supported, and pins protocol 25 for control-plane dispatch during rollout. F2 is resolved: the fake workspace host in ControlPlane.test.ts now rejects acceptEvent calls with any header other than 25, a new test checks that event delivery succeeds with protocol 25, and the file's existing runScheduled protocol check now runs because the file changed. I accept the won't-fix reply on F1: the dependent docs PR (#411) in the same atomic stack replaces the skill references, and this layer is never deployed alone. Both test tiers pass and the coverage gate passes.
